$comment: CONSUMER-DRIVEN PACT — consumers of the SharedReport interface. `wkrp` is PROVIDER-DECLARED and UNRATIFIED: it records what ourSharedEvents believes it owes the batch consumer, written without reading ourWKRP (R3 — no session spans both repos). It is verified against the provider snapshot like any other pact; `ratified` flips to true only when ourWKRP confirms these fields from its own side, in its own session.

consumers.$note: is_local is required INDEPENDENTLY of sponsor_tier — invariant #25, frequency-not-placement. A provider change that derived is_local from tier would still satisfy a field-presence check; the covenant specs are what assert independence. This pact pins presence only.
UNRATIFIED. Declared from the provider side only. Do not treat green here as evidence ourWKRP is satisfied.
